questions.q: What are the two trigger options when you create a scan?
options: Run it once, or set up a recurring schedule
Export it or import it
Public or private
Manual-only or disabled
questions.explain: When creating a scan, the trigger decision is simple: run it once, or set up a recurring schedule with its own cadence.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT one of the settings you configure for a recurring scan schedule?
options: Time zone
Recurrence (daily, weekly, or monthly)
An optional recurrence end date
The sensitivity label to apply to results
questions.explain: Recurring scan settings cover time zone, recurrence cadence, start date, and an optional end date. Sensitivity labels are a separate feature, not part of scan scheduling.

questions.q: Where can you find the count of scans that belong to a particular collection or domain?
options: Only by contacting Microsoft support
On that collection or domain's Overview tab, alongside its Assets and Sources counts
Scans aren't associated with collections or domains
Only in the Azure Monitor Metrics blade
questions.explain: Every collection and domain's Overview tab displays its own Assets, Sources, and Scans counts, and selecting Scans opens the full list for that collection or domain.

questions.q: What is the key difference between a Full Scan and an Incremental scan?
options: A Full Scan only works on SQL sources
Incremental scans apply classifications, Full Scans never do
A Full Scan re-reads everything in scope; an Incremental scan only processes what changed since the last run
There is no difference — they behave identically
questions.explain: A Full Scan re-reads the entire scope again. An Incremental scan only processes resources that changed since the last successful scan, which is faster and is the default behavior after a source's first scan.

questions.q: Before assuming a source supports incremental scanning, what should you check?
options: Nothing — all sources support incremental scanning identically
The source's own Supported capabilities table on its documentation page
The Azure subscription's billing tier
The scan rule set's version number
questions.explain: Not every data source supports incremental scanning — the Supported capabilities table on that specific source's documentation page confirms whether it's available before you rely on it.
